summary: Verification/hardening phase only -- no new Runtime Context functionality; src/pcae/core/runtime_context.py (112C) unchanged. Verified compatibility across all fourteen 110A-112C lineage phase documents, cross-checking runtime_context.py's constants directly against runtime_introspection.py (111B, cross-module) and against 112A/112B's own contract text (not just internal self-consistency). Re-verified structural immutability by attempting mutation on every field of every one of the twelve classes (all fail with FrozenInstanceError, including through a fully-composed seven-object chain and against the class-level OWNERSHIP object). Confirmed relationship-chain integrity end-to-end (RuntimeSession to TaskContext to PhaseContext to IntentContext to BrokerDecisionContext to ApprovalContext to EvidenceContext), ownership and persistence metadata against an independently-transcribed expected table (zero drift from 112B), and composition integrity (RuntimeContext carries exactly two fields, no god-object drift). Investigated the fast_green baseline's one pre-existing failure fresh rather than re-stating it, under two deliberately observed repository states: idle (4389/4390, test_dry_run_simulation.py Test89dMatrixReadOnly::test_pytest_dry_run_not_blocked fails) and mid-implementation with this phase's own active task present (4390/4390, the identical test passes) -- sharpening 112C's 4389/4390 into a deterministic function of live tasks/active/ state, not a fixed count, since the test reads the real repo root via build_simulation(REPO_ROOT, ...) rather than a hermetic fixture. Confirmed not a regression and documented why repairing it is out of this phase's scope, including the caveat that a future 4390/4390 result alone does not mean it was fixed. 100 new tests (tests/test_runtime_context_verification.py). Added docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_VERIFICATION.md.

pre_existing_failures.verification_method: reran fast_green under two observed repository states within this phase: idle (tasks/active/ empty) -> fails; with this phase's own task contract active -> passes
pre_existing_failures.root_cause: build_simulation(REPO_ROOT, ...) reads the real repository root, not a tmp_path fixture, so its result is a deterministic function of live tasks/active/ state; with no active task the classifier returns would_block_by_task_contract with would_require_active_task=False, a third outcome the test's own two-branch assertion (would_block is False or would_require_active_task) does not cover
pre_existing_failures.scope: repair belongs in src/pcae/core/dry_run.py or the test itself, neither an allowed file for 112D (Runtime Context Verification)
pre_existing_failures.caveat: a future fast_green report showing 4390/4390 for this test does not by itself mean the underlying issue was fixed -- check tasks/active/ state at the time

xdist_compatibility: All suites (focused, governance/autonomy, full release/lifecycle regression including phase85/87, fast_green under both observed states) ran cleanly under -n auto; the fast_green result difference is state-dependent (tasks/active/ presence), not an xdist-specific defect -- reproduces identically with or without -n auto.
